newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Anhui Expressway IPO seen oversubscribed in HK.
newsitem.headline: Anhui Expressway IPO seen oversubscribed in HK.

text.p: China toll operator Anhui Expressway Co Ltd was expected to be oversubscribed at the close of its initial public offering (IPO) of shares on Tuesday, market sources said.
Anhui Expressway has offered 493.01 million H-shares at HK$1.77 each, of which 85 percent would be placed outside Hong Kong, and 15 percent in the territory.
H-shares are shares of mainland Chinese companies listed in Hong Kong.
An official announcement on subscription results would be released on November 8 and dealing in the shares is expected to begin on November 13.
Anhui Expressway owns, operates and develops toll roads in China's inner Anhui province.
